entries.title: SQLite adapter excluded from build
entries.root_cause: The Go build omits the tidal_sqlite tag required by the echoweave adapter package. Add that tag to the build invocation.

entries.title: ICU index excluded from build
entries.root_cause: The Go build omits the tidal_icu tag required by the shoalindex package. Add that tag to the build invocation.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same Go build-constraints error now names shoalindex; it requires a different build tag from echoweave.

entries.title: ICU index excluded from build
entries.root_cause: The Go build omits the tidal_icu tag required by the shoalindex package. Add that tag to the build invocation.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later pull request runs go test with a different package selection and runner; the shoalindex files remain excluded.

entries.title: SQLite adapter excluded from build
entries.root_cause: The Go build omits the tidal_sqlite tag required by the echoweave adapter package. Add that tag to the build invocation.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later release build uses go build and a different workspace; the echoweave files are still excluded.
